name: Albaladejo (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albaladejo (a castle on yellow and a cross of Saint James).
history: Municipal flag of Albaladejo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
